t=np.asarray(df['t']);P=np.asarray(df['P']);y=np.asarray(df['dP_dt'])
base=[P*np.log(P),t,np.ones_like(t)]
def sc(gfun,ws):
    out=[]
    for w in ws:
        cols=[f/P for f in gfun(w)]+base
        X=np.column_stack(cols)
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)
        r=y-X@c
        out.append((np.mean(r**2)/np.var(y),w,c))
    out.sort(key=lambda z:z[0]); return out[0]

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    w = params[9]
    g = (params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*np.sqrt(t) + params[3]*np.exp(-t)
         + params[4]*np.sin(w*t) + params[5]*np.cos(w*t) + params[6]*np.log(t))
    return g/P + params[7]*P*np.log(P) + params[8]*t
